title: Connect the Office
source: Versioned setup checklist; dated evidence, not a live health check
nextStep: Publish and verify the full working connector, then approve ChatGPT and test a saved-record read, write and build status before repeating for Claude and Elsie.

steps.label: Custom connector installation option
steps.evidence: Owner created the ChatGPT plugin and reached the Office approval screen.

steps.label: Renewable Office authorization
steps.evidence: OAuth is enabled. The browser consent screen has been reached in a real ChatGPT attempt. No approved external client has yet been saved.

steps.label: Connect and test ChatGPT
steps.evidence: No authenticated saved-record read or renewal test has passed.

steps.label: Connect and test external Claude
steps.evidence: This client needs its own authorization and acceptance tests.

steps.label: Elsie reads the shared checklist
steps.evidence: The shared read-only checklist tool is installed in source. Signed-in use has not been verified.

steps.label: Shared Brain, files and skills for all three assistants
steps.evidence: Working tools for private owner records, Brain notes and memory, knowledge content, saved files, canonical skills and version-checked edits are implemented and pass isolated tests. Native acceptance is pending.

steps.label: Verify build permissions separately
steps.evidence: Working connector exposes the existing Office builders with current-request selection, configured spending controls and duplicate-request protection. Native build status and submission acceptance are pending.

steps.label: Verify mailbox permissions separately
steps.evidence: An Office connection does not establish mailbox authorization.

steps.label: Verify records, renewal and revocation
steps.evidence: Each external client must pass saved-record, renewal, signed-out and revoked-access checks.

goal: Persistent Office working access for ChatGPT and Claude: private owner records, shared Brain, files, skills, setup changes and app builds. Elsie coordinates the same records and handoffs. Do not reduce this to a status/checklist connection.
